prompt: Use case: product-mockup. ONE isolated wide low-profile wooden consultation table for a refined medical paper-theatre animation. View from the FRONT at a slight downward angle so the tabletop is a narrow usable horizontal plane and all four legs are visible. Physical proportions approximately 220 cm wide, 75 cm high, 65 cm deep; overall silhouette about three times wider than high, NOT a tiny square side table, NOT a toy stool. Straight warm honey-brown plank tabletop, simple slim sturdy wooden legs and a lower connecting stretcher; no drawer, chair, object, cloth or person. Hand-painted watercolor/gouache and colored-pencil fibrous cut-paper collage, carefully drawn wood grain, tactile paper edges and gentle intrinsic shading, matching handmade Chinese medical explainers. Entire table fully within generous transparent margins, including all feet. Genuine RGBA transparency outside the table and between its legs; no floor shadow plate, room, wall, text or ambient halo. High-quality raster furniture cutout, no simple vector rectangles.
